title: ColdStartPlanRequest
description: Content-free local capability and budget descriptor for a cold-start plan. Source material, names, paths, prompts, examples, rows, results, logs, scores, descriptions, and arbitrary metadata are not permitted. SCOPE OF THE GUARANTEE: 'content-free' means no field can carry customer content — every property is a closed enum or a bounded integer, and additionalProperties is false at every level. It does NOT mean zero bits are disclosed: arity, the ordered type-class vector, declared verifier/generation capabilities, and the requested candidate limit are coarse SHAPE metadata and are necessarily visible to the planner. That residual shape disclosure is accepted deliberately — a planner that learns nothing about the target cannot plan for it. A caller determined to misuse those bounded fields as a covert channel could encode a small number of bits, which is inherent to any API with caller-controlled parameters and is not defended against here.

descriptor.description: Positional type classes and local verifier and generation capabilities only; no code or content. TWO CONSTRAINTS THIS SCHEMA CANNOT EXPRESS, both enforced server-side and each returning 422: (1) input_kinds MUST have exactly input_arity entries — JSON Schema draft-07 cannot tie an array length to a sibling integer, so a mismatch is schema-valid but refused (reason=descriptor_arity_mismatch); (2) verifier_kinds and generation_capabilities MAY be empty here, and empty is deliberately schema-valid so a caller can honestly declare 'I have no local scoring authority' — the server then refuses to issue a plan (reason=no_local_scoring_authority / no_local_generation_capability) rather than producing rows nothing could score.

budget.description: Bounded local request limits only. candidate_limit is an ASK; the response carries the GRANT. Deliberately has no optimizer-eligibility knob: how many accepted rows become optimizer-eligible is decided locally by the scoring authority, and a server field the server never reads would be a control that does nothing.
